actionable_steps.citation: Seva is the highest Sadhana — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 18 (1985)
actionable_steps.step: Serve the poor in the villages — it is the best form of sadhana.

actionable_steps.citation: Seva is the highest Sadhana — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 18 (1985)
actionable_steps.step: Serve without expectation of reward or recognition — that is when God's grace comes; cut down ego and attachment the moment they rear their heads.

actionable_steps.citation: Teaching is a saadhana — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 14 (1978 - 80), 1978-07-25
actionable_steps.step: When you get a chance to help someone, rejoice at your good fortune — engage in humble service and egotism will fade away.

actionable_steps.citation: Equipment for service — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 19 (1986), 1986-11-21
actionable_steps.step: Remember why you got this body: it was awarded to you for helping the helpless — Paropakarartham idam sareeram.

actionable_steps.citation: Lessons on seva saadhana — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 15 (1981 - 82), 1981-11-19
actionable_steps.step: Let Compassion and Sacrifice be your two eyes, Egolessness your breath, and Love your tongue whenever you serve.
Never serve with the attitude of doing it for your own satisfaction — and in the name of seva, inflict no harm, pain or grief on anyone.

definition.citation: Seva is the highest Sadhana — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 18 (1985)
definition.quote: Seva is a small word but is filled with immense spiritual significance. … Seva must be viewed as the highest form of sadhana.

discourses.citation: Service to Man is Service to God — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 37 (2004), 2004-01-01
discourses.quote: Service to man is service to God. … There is no greater sadhana than such service. … Service is more important than bhajan and all other sadhanas (spiritual disciplines).

discourses.citation: Limbs of the Divine Body — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 7 (1967), 1967-03-29
discourses.quote: It is the very essence of Bhakthi, the very breath of a Bhaktha (devotee), his very nature. … Do Seva as a Sadhana; then you will be humble and happy. … The real value of Seva, its most visible result, is that it reforms you, reshapes you.

discourses.citation: No bumps, no jumps — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 13 (1975 - 77), 1975-11-15
discourses.quote: Through seva you realise that all beings are waves of the Ocean of Divinity. No other sadhana can bring you into the incessant contemplation of the Oneness of all living beings. … To see every one else as yourself and yourself in every one, that is the core of the sadhana of seva.

discourses.citation: God Incarnates To Serve Mankind — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 33 (2000), 2000-11-20
discourses.quote: Just as the birds have two wings which help them to fly, Love and service are the two wings which enable man to reach his goal of life quickly.

make_it_real: You aren't really serving 'others' — the same Atma is in all. Do one quiet act of service today and watch your ego shrink.
title: Seva / Selfless Service

vahinis.quote: Service to fellow beings is service to God. … Of course, the individual pursuing the goal is also a beneficiary, since he is part of the living community that he serves.
Prompted by the urge to advance the progress of others, a person who dedicates their wealth, skill, and intelligence, their position and status, becomes truly great.
But the essence of service is selflessness and abnegation of the fruit thereof.
